jobs.occupation: New model for activated sludge flocculation integrating cellular biochemical reaction potential with the microbial ecology
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institit for Bio- og Kemitekn
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Biological and Chemical Engineering programme. The position is based on a collaboration between Novonesis and Aarhus University and is available from 15 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
New model for activated sludge flocculation integrating cellular biochemical reaction potential with the microbial ecology

Research area and project description
While bacterial and activated sludge flocculation is the most important component of wastewater treatment processes, mechanisms governing flocculation are poorly understood. It is difficult to control and optimize activated sludge flocculation, and so downstream clarifiers for removing activated sludge from treated water are overdesigned or overloaded.

Effective flocculation is currently explained in terms of achieving the right balance between good and bad flocculating bacteria. Industrial wastewater treatment plants commonly experience poor flocculating sludges with impaired flocculation, which is attributed to too many bad flocculating bacteria. However, there is in fact a poor correlation between the microbial ecology of industrial wastewater treatment activated sludges and flocculation.
In this project the candidate will build on ongoing research in the host lab demonstrating that biochemical reactions occur within activation sludge that also likely promote flocculation The candidate will establish abiotic and biotic activated sludge models, assess the effect of flocculation stressors characteristic of industrial wastewaters, as well as biological, chemical and mechanical strategies for overcoming these. The research will inform strategies for the industrial to consider to increase the hydraulic of their wastewater treatment plant.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must have a relevant master's degree in biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, biological or chemical engineering or a closely related field.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work will be divided approximately evenly between Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering, Ole Worms Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark, and Novonesis, Hallas Alle 1, 4400 Kalundborg, Denmark.

Contacts

• Professor Barth Smets, e-mail: Bfsm@bce.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Formalities and salary range

jobs.occupation: Postdoc at CBS in work-life balance policy: citizens, policies and firms
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a vacant postdoc position in work-life balance policy: citizens, policies and firms, at the Department of International Economics, Government & Business.

Expected starting date is 1 March 2027.

EGB is a multidisciplinary department that conducts high-quality research in the fields of international business and political science with direct relevance to business, policymakers, and the public. Research at the department focuses on two principal focus areas, Business & Government and International Business, in relation to societal challenges. These challenges include the consequences of inequality; the impact of technological change and digital transformation; the ethical dilemmas facing MNEs, regulating societal challenges, the changes brought about by emerging markets and the rise of Asia; the consequences of global shifts for public policy, and the relationship between business and democracy. 

Faculty apply advanced quantitative and qualitative methods to generate systematic knowledge about business-government relations and international business relations. To learn more about the research and education of the department, please visit the departmental website.

Much of EGB’s teaching is affiliated with the BSc/MSc in International Business and Politics (IBP); the BSc/MSc in International Business (IB); and the BSc in International Business in Asia (IBA).

The postdoc is to be recruited for a project funded by the Velux Foundation entitled ‘AchievinG work-LIFE balance: citizens, policies and firm perspectives (AGILE work-life balance)’, led by PI Caroline de la Porte. Read the synopsis of the project here (in Danish): VELUX FONDEN fremmer viden om vores kultur, historie og samfund: Støtter grundforskning med 40 mio. kroner | Velux and the website (in English) here: https://agile-wlb.cbs.dk/. The project focuses on values and preferences (citizen perspective), policies, and practices (firm-level) regarding work-care-life balance in four different countries and at EU level.

It would be an advantage to have a sociological background, with a focus on leisure and care intersections. The recruited postdoc is also expected to have a particular expertise in collecting interview data (citizens in different sectors & social partners) as well as survey design. It would be preferable that the candidate has some country-specific expertise on Austria, which is one of four case countries. The research will be undertaken in English, and the broader dissemination of the project results will be in Danish and English.

The postdoc is a non-tenured position for 1 year and 10 months with teaching obligation of 40%.

To fulfill the research requirements of the position, the applicant chosen is expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of the department.

Qualifications

The applicant must hold a PhD or the equivalent in the social sciences, preferably in sociology. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on research potential.

Emphasis is placed on research relevant to the job description.

The applicant must have professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).

Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type (highlighting, for example, relevant professional, educational and dissemination activities).

For further information on the department please contact: Head of Department Jens Gammelgaard, e-mail: jg.egb@cbs.dk. For information about the AGILE project and your concrete expected tasks, please contact PI Caroline de la Porte, Tel: +4541852462, e-mail: cdlp.egb@cbs.dk

Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/egb.

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link below.

Application must include

• A summary of the candidate’s main strengthens and abilities.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review are allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, industry co-operation and international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level.
• Transcript(s) and a full CV

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist minimum two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Closing date: 7 December 2026.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk.

The position
The Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM) at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), seeks outstanding candidates to fill a number of 2-3-year postdoctoral positions in Quantum Mathematics with emphasis on pure mathematics with relations to quantum theory.
The targeted starting date of the position is 01.08.2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM)
Over the past seven years, QM has built a highly international and interdisciplinary research environment spanning a broad spectrum of pure mathematics, mathematical physics and quantum computer science. The Centre has attracted leading international researchers to Odense and developed a unique research environment spanning both fundamental and applied research.
The University of Southern Denmark has recently invested DKK 50 million in the Centre for Quantum Mathematics, on top of its continuous substantial basic funding of the centre, which will enable the Centre to further expand its scientific capacity, attract and retain leading international researchers, increase the acquisition of competitive external research funding and establish strategic collaborations with industry, public authorities and international partners.
As part of this continued development and expansion, QM will move into a new dedicated building from next year. The new building will be located on the SDU campus in Odense and will provide a dedicated research environment for the Centre and its growing international research community.
Research activities and funding
The QM centre is located at the Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark and it is hosting several large European, Danish and American grants including “New Structures in Low-Dimensional Topology” (Simons Collaboration) & “Topological Photonic Quantum Computing and its Applications” (Innovation Fund Denmark) both led by PI and Centre Director Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen; “Mathematics of the open topological string” (VILLUM Investigator) led by Professor Vivek Shende; “The Quantum Geometry of Dynamical Systems” (VILLUM Ascending Investigator) and “The Emergent Geometry of Categories” (DFF Sapere Aude) both led by Associate Professor Fabian Haiden; “New invariants in low-dimensional topology via quantum field theory” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Associate Professor Du Pei, “Global Categorical Symmetries and Phases of Quantum Matter” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Assistant Professor Apoorv Tiwari, “From Pertubative to Non-pertubative Quantum Field Theory by cutting and gluing” (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Assistant Professor Konstantin Wernli and finally “Leveraging Algebraic Geometry for High-Precision Fundamental Physics“ (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Associate Professor Matthias Wilhelm.

Job description
A successful candidate will help drive internationally competitive research, collaborate with the world community in the field and contribute to QM’s excellent research environment.
The candidates will get the opportunity to shape this development together with the team and implement research project ideas with national and international impact. 
Topics of interest: Algebra, algebraic geometry, differential geometry, algebraic topology, complex geometry, quantum topology, geometric analysis, operator algebra, number theory statistics, probability theory and mathematical physics.

We expect
The candidates must have a PhD degree in algebra, algebraic geometry, differential geometry, algebraic topology, complex geometry, quantum topology, geometric analysis, operator algebra, number theory, statistic, probability theory, mathematical physics or quantum algorithms, quantum software architecture. 
The candidates must further have an emerging research track in the field. We are seeking highly motivated candidates, who work and communicate well in an international team. The candidates must be able to carry out independent and rigorous work at top international level.
Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a prerequisite for application. The hired candidate will be offered Danish courses by the university.

Living and working in Odense
Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs.

Application deadline: 3. January 2027 at 23:59 hours local Danish time
Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Are you an experienced OT SCADA professional who wants to help secure the reliable operation of business-critical systems? Would you like to apply your technical expertise in an operational technology environment supporting the future of renewable energy?

As our new OT SCADA Engineer (Integration & Operations), you will be responsible for engineering, integrating, maintaining, operating, and continuously improving SCADA systems, ensuring data flows between power plants, market-facing control applications used by BA Markets, the Operational Control Centre’s monitoring and control systems, and other data consumers underpinning Vattenfall’s business-critical renewable-energy Operational Technology applications.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support business-critical services that operate around the clock. You will help restore service during incidents and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

A key part of your role will be applying structured engineering, security and lifecycle-management principles to keep the platforms reliable, supportable and compliant with Vattenfall standards and operational requirements. You will work closely with internal colleagues, external stakeholders and suppliers.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Your role

As an OT SCADA Engineer, you will take ownership of SCADA systems and related data flows throughout their lifecycle, from initial analysis and engineering through implementation, operation, improvement and eventual replacement or decommissioning.

You will combine hands-on technical work with structured planning, documentation, and collaboration. Your focus will be on maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable SCADA systems and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen performance, availability, and operational resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Engineering, configuring, commissioning, maintaining, and improving OT SCADA solutions and interfaces for assets in operation and development.

• 
Delivering and supporting reliable data flows from plant-level systems through approved OT integration layers to monitoring, control, analytics, reporting, and data-platform consumers.

• 
Assessing site and interface readiness, identifying integration prerequisites, technical constraints, dependencies, risks and ownership boundaries, and defining requirements and integration approaches.

• 
Configuring, deploying, and supporting resilient SCADA integration components, including industrial edge devices or gateways, connectors, and data pipelines, with appropriate monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment documentation, and operational handover.

• 
Planning, estimating, and tracking assigned work, making dependencies, risks, and progress visible, and documenting and maintaining technical records and operational knowledge.

• 
Providing operational support, including incident diagnosis, service restoration, root-cause and problem analysis, defining and implementing preventive and proactive improvement actions.

• 
Participating in the team's on-call rotation, providing specialist OT SCADA support for business-critical services outside normal working hours.

• 
Improving observability and data quality through health monitoring, completeness checks, alerting, backfilling support, performance analysis, and clear operational ownership.

• 
Planning and executing lifecycle upgrades, migrations, patches, configuration changes, and component replacements using approved change and DTAP practices.

• 
Producing requirements, designs, implementation guides, configuration records, test cases, support documentation, and operational handover packages including operational runbooks, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements

• 
Supporting technical purchasing and supplier coordination through technical evaluations, solution validation, and design reviews.

• 
Preparing and executing tests and commissioning checks for assigned solutions, recording test evidence, tracking defects to resolution, and supporting factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), acceptance decisions, and operational-readiness assessments.

• 
Standardizing repeatable integration services and work packages for asset projects, while supporting refinement and estimation of less standardized initiatives.

• 
Supporting internal and external audit activities.

Your profile

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation or control engineering, computer engineering, technical computer science, industrial IT, or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial experience in OT SCADA engineering.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, integrating, and supporting SCADA systems or comparable industrial OT solutions, including responsibility for systems in operation. You thrive when taking ownership of solutions from analysis and design through to implementation, operation, and continuous improvement. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organisation. To succeed in this role, you must have excellent written and spoken English skills. The role may also be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• SCADA systems and interfaces: configuring, integrating, commissioning, managing, maintaining, operating, and supporting SCADA applications, gateways, and interfaces connecting operational assets with central systems and data consumers.

• Industrial communications: working with relevant industrial protocols such as OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP or MQTT, as well as APIs and vendor-specific interfaces where applicable, and diagnosing communication and integration issues.

• Operational resilience: practical understanding of high availability, service monitoring and logging, SCADA application and configuration backup and recovery, and configuration management, including dependencies on hosting and network services.

• Operational data flows: understanding signal mapping, timestamps, data quality, buffering, and the recovery of missing historical data.

• Incident and problem management: diagnosing faults across SCADA applications, interfaces, source and target systems, including dependencies on server services, networks, certificates and service accounts; restoring services; investigating root causes; and implementing preventive and proactive improvements.

• Controlled technical changes: planning and delivering upgrades, migrations and configuration changes with appropriate testing, deployment documentation, rollback arrangements and operational handover.

• Secure OT operation: applying OT security requirements, including access controls, certificate handling, system hardening and vulnerability management, within approved architectures and change procedures and in collaboration with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

• Engineering documentation: producing and maintaining clear technical documentation of SCADA system architectures, configurations and procedures.

• Supplier collaboration: supporting technical purchasing, assessing and validating solutions, supporting acceptance testing and coordinating technical work with colleagues and external suppliers.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

• Renewable energy, utilities or comparable industrial environments.

• OEM SCADA interfaces.

• Industrial edge platforms or gateways.

• SCADA historians, SQL databases, scripting and automation.

Personal traits

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

• Bring strong analytical skills, approach technical challenges with proactive, structured problem-solving, and remain composed when resolving operational incidents.

• Communicate clearly and can connect technical, operational and supplier-related perspectives.

• Are comfortable taking end-to-end responsibility, from analysis and planning through implementation and delivery.

• Work independently while contributing actively and collaborating effectively across disciplines with internal and external stakeholders.

• Are organised, reliable and committed to high-quality documentation.

• Take a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

• Use sound judgment to balance immediate service restoration, long-term reliability, maintainability and agreed delivery priorities.

• Are willing to participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Kolding

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Steffen Hellmich, steffen.hellmich@vattenfall.de. For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 22-11-2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We’re looking for a Commercial Enablement Manager to drive commercial readiness and effectiveness across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and our partner network. Using data, customer insight and market intelligence, you’ll shape our enablement strategy to strengthen our value proposition, focus on the right opportunities and drive measurable revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you’ll join our newly established Revenue Operations & Commercial Strategy team, alongside Business Intelligence, Marketing Automation & AI, and Product Marketing. Together, we own the commercial revenue engine across Sales and Marketing.

Your focus will be turning insight into action to improve pipeline, conversion, retention and cross-sell. You’ll play a key role in our 2027 priorities, including ABM in priority sectors, growth in DACH and the Nordics, partnerships and portfolio cross-sell.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As our Commercial Enablement Manager, you’ll own the commercial enablement strategy and execution, roadmap and performance across Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. Through combining strategic direction with data-driven decision-making, you’ll equip our teams and partners to turn commercial opportunities into results.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Align programmes, content and priorities with commercial objectives, product strategy and brand positioning across all three brands.

• Partner with BI and RevOps to analyse CRM, pipeline, win/loss, sales conversation and customer data, identify performance gaps and measure revenue impact.

• Develop account- and sector-specific playbooks, messaging, competitive positioning, objection handling and customer proof points across the buying and renewal journey.

• Lead our commercial events strategy by setting objectives and target-account strategies for conferences, executive events and partner events, and measuring their impact on pipeline and customer relationships in collaboration with our events agency.

• Turn insights from Sales, CS, customers and partners into actionable improvements for Marketing, Product and RevOps.

• Own partner enablement by shaping partner onboarding, certification, train-the-trainer programmes, co-branded resources and sector initiatives that help agency and reseller partners sell our portfolio independently.

• Support launches, new propositions and priority segments, measuring adoption, knowledge and field effectiveness to continuously improve enablement.

• Equip customer-facing teams and partners to communicate our value in marketing analytics, privacy-first data and compliance.

**About You

**You’re a strategic, data-driven commercial thinker who turns customer insight and business performance into practical action. You understand that effective enablement is about driving measurable improvements, not simply producing more content or training. You’re comfortable setting direction, influencing stakeholders and owning outcomes, while staying close to what customer-facing teams need to succeed.

You bring:

• Stakeholder leadership through cross-functional team alignment, influence without direct authority and coordination of internal stakeholders and external agencies towards shared goals.
